tagline.en: New Haven to Derby Line, up the Connecticut River
tagline.zh: 自纽黑文沿康涅狄格河北上至德比莱恩

mileageSource: FHWA Route Log and Finder List, Table 1, January 2026

start.zh: 康涅狄格州纽黑文，与 I-95 相接

end.en: The Canadian border at Derby Line, Vermont
end.zh: 佛蒙特州德比莱恩的加拿大边境

en: I-91 follows the Connecticut River for nearly its whole length, from the coast at New Haven through Hartford and Springfield and then up the river valley to the Canadian border at Derby Line. It is the spine of the valley, and it replaced US 5, which it parallels almost continuously.

The southern third is urban. Between New Haven and Springfield it runs through two state capitals and the most built-up part of the valley, on elevated structure in places and close beside active railway lines. North of the Massachusetts line it empties out quickly; by the time it reaches the Northeast Kingdom it is a two-lane-each-way road through forest with exits many miles apart.
Vermont has more of it than either other state — more than half the total. That is why the road matters so much there, and why its construction was argued over farm by farm.
zh: I-91 几乎全程沿康涅狄格河而行：自纽黑文的海岸起，经哈特福德与斯普林菲尔德，再沿河谷北上至德比莱恩的加拿大边境。它是这条河谷的脊梁，取代了与其几乎处处平行的 US 5。
南边三分之一是城市路段。纽黑文与斯普林菲尔德之间，它穿过两座州首府与河谷中开发最密集的地带，部分路段为高架，并与运营中的铁路线紧邻。过了马萨诸塞州界，很快就空旷下来；到了「东北王国」一带，它已是双向各两车道、穿行森林、出口相隔数英里的道路。
佛蒙特州拥有的里程比另外两州都多——超过总长的一半。这正是这条路在当地如此重要的原因，也是它当年一块农田一块农田地被争论过来的原因。

en: Vermont went first. The section from the Massachusetts line north to the Brattleboro area opened on 1 November 1958 and was the first controlled-access highway completed in the state. Construction then worked north in short pieces through the 1960s, with sections opening at Brattleboro, Putney, Westminster, Rockingham and Ascutney, and an isolated piece at Derby near the border as early as 1962.

Massachusetts opened its first two stretches in 1960, at the Connecticut and Vermont ends, and closed its last gap in 1970 with the 6.3 miles through Springfield, Chicopee and West Springfield. That final piece included the decision to carry the road across the Connecticut River onto the Springfield side, next to the railway — a choice made to serve waterfront urban renewal and later widely regarded as having cut the city off from its river.

The route was finished in Vermont. On 17 October 1978 several hundred people gathered on new blacktop in St Johnsbury for the opening of the Barnet–Waterford–St Johnsbury section, the last on the road. Governor Richard Snelling called the state's highways arteries circulating the blood of Vermont. The final sections of I-89 and I-93 in the state followed about four years later.
zh: 佛蒙特州先行。自马萨诸塞州界向北至布拉特尔伯勒一带的路段于 1958 年 11 月 1 日通车，是该州建成的第一条限制出入公路。此后施工以短段为单位逐步北推，贯穿整个 1960 年代，布拉特尔伯勒、普特尼、威斯敏斯特、罗金厄姆与阿斯卡特尼等地陆续通车；早在 1962 年，边境附近的德比就已有一段孤立路段建成。
马萨诸塞州于 1960 年在康涅狄格与佛蒙特两端各通车一段，并于 1970 年以斯普林菲尔德、奇科皮与西斯普林菲尔德之间的 6.3 英里补上最后的缺口。这最后一段包含了一项决定：让道路跨过康涅狄格河、贴着铁路走斯普林菲尔德一侧——此举当年是为配合滨水区的城市更新，后来则被普遍认为把这座城市与它的河隔断了。
全线是在佛蒙特州收尾的。1978 年 10 月 17 日，数百人聚集在圣约翰斯伯里新铺的沥青路面上，为巴尼特—沃特福德—圣约翰斯伯里路段通车。这是全线最后一段。理查德·斯内林州长称，该州的公路是把佛蒙特的血液输送至全身的动脉。该州 I-89 与 I-93 的最后路段则在大约四年后完成。

en: The Springfield viaduct is the most demanding structure on the route. Completed in 1970, it carries I-91 across the Connecticut River and along the edge of downtown, and by the 2010s it needed frequent emergency repairs that made congestion worse each time. A renovation in 2001 was not enough; an inspection in 2014 recommended replacing the entire deck.

MassDOT put the work out as a single large contract with unusually sharp schedule incentives — payment or deduction of a fixed sum for each day early or late, up to a cap — and the contractor used accelerated bridge construction to keep two lanes open in each direction throughout. Demolition of the old deck began in February 2016.

Full use of the road was restored in January 2018, about nine months ahead of schedule, with the contract formally closing out in February 2019. The rebuilt viaduct has slightly wider shoulders, new lighting and stormwater treatment, and was expected to cut emergency repairs for about thirty years.
zh: 斯普林菲尔德高架桥是全线最棘手的结构。它建成于 1970 年，承载 I-91 跨越康涅狄格河并沿市中心边缘而行；到 2010 年代，它需要频繁的紧急抢修，而每次抢修都会加剧拥堵。2001 年的一次翻修并不足够；2014 年的检测建议更换整幅桥面。
马萨诸塞州交通部把这项工程作为一个大合同发包，并设置了异常严格的工期奖惩——每提前或延误一天，按固定金额奖励或扣款，设有上限——承包商采用快速桥梁施工法，全程保持双向各两条车道通行。旧桥面的拆除自 2016 年 2 月开始。
道路于 2018 年 1 月恢复全面使用，比计划提前约九个月，合同于 2019 年 2 月正式结算。重建后的高架桥路肩略有加宽，并更新了照明与雨水处理设施，预计可在约三十年内减少紧急抢修。

label.zh: 斯普林菲尔德 I-91 高架桥修复工程

value.en: About $183 million total project cost, including a $148 million construction contract; funded 80 percent federal and 20 percent state
value.zh: 工程总造价约 1.83 亿美元，其中施工合同 1.48 亿美元；联邦出资 80%、州出资 20%

figures.source: Bridge Design & Engineering, 16 April 2015; ITS International project report

label.en: Schedule incentive on the viaduct contract
label.zh: 高架桥合同的工期奖惩

value.en: $50,000 per day for early completion, up to 180 days, with a matching deduction for running late
value.zh: 提前完工每天奖励 5 万美元，最多 180 天；延误则按同等金额扣款

value.en: 290.51 miles: 177.43 in Vermont, 58.17 in Connecticut and 54.91 in Massachusetts
value.zh: 290.51 英里：佛蒙特州 177.43 英里，康涅狄格州 58.17 英里，马萨诸塞州 54.91 英里

figures.source: FHWA Route Log and Finder List, Table 1, January 2026

why.en: Three state transportation departments publish counts by segment, and volumes on this route differ by roughly an order of magnitude between Springfield and northern Vermont. No route-wide figure is published.
why.zh: 三个州的交通部门按路段发布交通量，而本路线在斯普林菲尔德与佛蒙特北部之间的数值相差约一个数量级。未发布全线数字。

timeline.en: The first section opens in Vermont on 1 November, the state's first controlled-access highway.
timeline.zh: 11 月 1 日，佛蒙特州首段通车，为该州第一条限制出入公路。

timeline.en: Massachusetts completes its last 6.3 miles through Springfield, Chicopee and West Springfield, including the river viaduct.
timeline.zh: 马萨诸塞州建成穿过斯普林菲尔德、奇科皮与西斯普林菲尔德的最后 6.3 英里，含跨河高架桥。

timeline.en: The Barnet–Waterford–St Johnsbury section opens on 17 October, completing the route to the Canadian border.
timeline.zh: 10 月 17 日，巴尼特—沃特福德—圣约翰斯伯里路段通车，本路线贯通至加拿大边境。

timeline.en: Work begins on replacing the deck of the Springfield viaduct.
timeline.zh: 斯普林菲尔德高架桥桥面更换工程开工。

timeline.en: Full use of the rebuilt viaduct is restored in January, about nine months early.
timeline.zh: 1 月，重建后的高架桥恢复全面使用，比计划提前约九个月。
